problem: Prior EQA agents lack comprehensive understanding of the observed environment: the QA module ignores temporal context across multiple observations and has weak semantic understanding, and the navigator struggles to combine global spatial context with individual observations to understand geometry.
motivation: EQA requires actively exploring and gathering visual evidence to answer questions, so both where the agent goes and how it aggregates observations matter. Better temporal/semantic context for answering and better global geometric history for navigation should improve the whole EQA pipeline.
key_idea: CaEQA adds a local temporal context-aware VQA module (LTC-VQA) that uses an LLM to fuse temporal context into endpoint image embeddings, and a global-geometric-guided navigation module (G3-Nav) that uses a transformer over RGB, depth and actions from all past positions.
insight: Only the abstract is available, so no ablations can be cited. The paper's claim is that LLM pretraining knowledge helps temporal and semantic understanding of unseen environments, and that modeling the full navigation history with a transformer gives geometric hints from inter-image and intra-image perspectives.
method: LTC-VQA: local temporal context-aware VQA module that integrates temporal context into image embeddings from local observations at the navigation endpoint
LLM in QA module: a large language model introduces general knowledge from pretraining to improve temporal and semantic understanding of unseen environments
G3-Nav: global-geometric-guided navigation module that models dependencies across the whole navigation procedure
G3-Nav transformer: takes RGB images, depth maps and actions from all past positions to provide inter-image and intra-image geometric hints

setting.backbone: LLM-based QA module plus transformer-based navigator (specific models not stated in abstract)
setting.training_data: not stated in abstract; evaluated on Matterport3D and House3D EQA datasets
setting.observation: egocentric RGB + depth + past actions history

results: The abstract claims CaEQA outperforms SoTA methods on navigation, question answering and the overall EQA system on the Matterport3D and House3D datasets. No numbers are given.
limitations: Only the abstract was available, so details and numbers are unverified
Evaluated only in simulation on Matterport3D and House3D, with no real-robot evidence stated
